summary: Fixes for the Greptile review of the maintained Klaviyo CLI: MCP cannot manage client profiles; receipt finalization errors are printed and probe retries are counted; analytics declarations match each report's real output and are checked before display filters; SMS, push and WhatsApp campaigns pass the send preflight; first-time store creation and legacy migration are race-safe and never delete another opener's database; gated commands keep terminal tables; receipts use each command's real lookback flag and capture delivered stdout; sync runs parent resources before dependents; auth accounts writes honor --dry-run. Reports follow links.next and merge every page; plan qa-gate --campaign-id checks every email message; the cache fingerprint key is published complete with a no-replace link; a canceled rate-limit wait gives back its reservation.
reason: Greptile's review of mvanhorn/printing-press-library#2454 found these defects in the tenant-gated platform layer and analytics wrapper. Several blocked real work: SMS-only campaigns could not be sent, valid reports were rejected as all-null, and a bound MCP server could be re-pointed at another account.
validated_outcome: Regression tests for each finding fail before and pass after; go build, go vet and go test ./... pass for the CLI.
